description: Phase 1 — Real data binding. Add `--data <file.json>`; run each component's setup() in a hardened node:vm sandbox (no require/fs/network/process/timers, timed) to compute true build-time state; three-layer prop merge (manifest defaults <- data) with required-prop validation; bake the SAME merged props into the glue so first paint equals build-time state. Introduces the shared bareComputedKey helper (reused by Phase 4) and populates scope.computed. Foundational: every later phase reuses resolveProps + runSetup.
steps: Create src/behavior/compute-key.ts exporting bareComputedKey(exportName): strip leading 'get' (3 chars), lowercase ONLY the first remaining char, leave the rest verbatim (getDisplayName->displayName, getURL->uRL, getX->x). Export from src/index.ts.

Create src/behavior/run.ts exporting runSetup(behaviorSrc, props, behavior, opts?): {state, computed} using node:vm, per design Phase 1 'Sandbox construction': (a) Object.freeze a minimal seed of provided globals (Object,Array,String,Number,Boolean,Math,JSON,Date,RegExp,Map,Set,Symbol,Infinity,NaN,undefined, a no-op console whose methods return undefined, a no-op `emit` returning undefined), OMIT require/module/exports/process/global/globalThis/Buffer/setTimeout/setInterval/setImmediate/fetch/import/node:*; (b) strip ONLY the leading 'export ' keyword token of each EXPORT_RE match (reuse src/behavior/scan.ts's EXPORT_RE), splicing left-to-right so export function|async function|function*|const|let|var all survive as plain declarations; (c) if !behavior.hasSetup throw the exact `Missing required export "setup"` error BEFORE appending any invocation; (d) inject globalThis.__ADX_PROPS__ = props into the context, append `;globalThis.__ADX_STATE__ = setup(globalThis.__ADX_PROPS__);`, compile one vm.Script and run one timed runInContext(ctx,{timeout: opts?.timeoutMs ?? 1000}); read ctx.__ADX_STATE__ back with NO clone (same reference handed to emitter and to get* thunks); if setup returns a non-object treat as {}; (e) build computed as a map bareComputedKey(name)->thunk, each thunk a pre-compiled per-get* vm.Script `globalThis.__ADX_COMPUTED__ = <getName>(globalThis.__ADX_STATE__);` run under its OWN timed runInContext, reading ctx.__ADX_COMPUTED__ immediately; list get* names in the scanner's sorted order.

Map all sandbox failures to AdxError on 'behavior.adx.js' (line-less) via adxFileError, exact strings from the Phase 1 error table: ReferenceError/throw -> `setup() failed: <message>`; timeout -> `setup() exceeded time budget (1000ms)`; missing setup -> `Missing required export "setup"`. Export runSetup from src/index.ts.

Add resolveProps(manifest, data, source: 'standalone'|'page'|'composed') to src/compile.ts: merged = defaultProps(manifest) overlaid by data (shallow, data wins); for each required prop with no own value throw line-less `[ADX] manifest.json - Missing required prop "<name>" (<hint>)` with hint per source: standalone='no default and none supplied via --data', page='no default and no value in the page's component data', composed='no default and no value passed by the parent'. Keep the stem `Missing required prop "<name>" (no default and ...` identical across sources.

Add `data?: Record<string, unknown>` to CompileOptions. In compileComponent: mergedProps = resolveProps(manifest, opts.data, 'standalone'); call runSetup(behaviorSrc, mergedProps, behavior) -> state + computed; set scope = { state, props: mergedProps, computed } (build computed map keyed by bareComputedKey). Extend CodegenContext (src/codegen/context.ts) with mergedProps and store it. Keep scopeId(manifest.name, basename(dir)) for the single-component path. checkComponent runs the same path (so `check` now enforces required props).

In src/codegen/glue.ts change buildProps to read ctx.mergedProps (the exact object the HTML was built from) instead of recomputing manifest defaults; keep the globalThis.__ADX_PROPS__[Component] override merged on top. (Per-instance INSTANCES loop lands in FEAT-003; this feature only fixes the props source.)

Add --data <file.json> to src/cli.ts parseArgs (mirror --tokens: read next argv into parsed.data path). The CLI reads+parses the JSON file and passes the object as opts.data, with fatal CLI errors `[ADX] <data-file> - Cannot read data file` / `[ADX] <data-file> - Invalid JSON` / `[ADX] <data-file> - Data must be a JSON object of props`.

Add fixtures/user-card/data.json = {"name":"Ada Lovelace"}. Update test/compile.test.ts and test/seo-contract.test.ts to pass { tokensPath, data: { name: 'Ada Lovelace' } } (the fixture `name` is required with no default) and add an assertion that the <h2> is non-empty / contains the name.

Add jsdom as a devDependency (keep it OUT of package.json files allowlist). Add test/behavior-run.test.ts (benign setup; export const setup vs export function setup both yield the same state; require('fs')->ReferenceError-mapped [ADX] error; while(true){} -> timeout error; getDisplayName collected as displayName; unused get* never invoked; no-setup fatal before invocation), test/compute-key.test.ts (table incl. getURL->uRL), test/resolve-props.test.ts (merge precedence + each source hint), and test/hydrate-parity.test.ts (compile with data, render HTML into jsdom, run the glue module, assert DOM text/attrs unchanged before any event).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` is tsc-clean and `npm test` passes: all previously-green M1 tests (compile.test.ts and seo-contract.test.ts updated to supply data) plus the new Phase 1 suites.
Compiling the user-card fixture with data { name: 'Ada Lovelace' } emits a non-empty <h2> and zero '{{' in the HTML.

A component whose setup() references require/fs/process fails compilation with the exact `[ADX] behavior.adx.js - setup() failed: <message>` error; an infinite-loop setup fails with `[ADX] behavior.adx.js - setup() exceeded time budget (1000ms)`.
A required prop with neither default nor supplied value fails with the exact line-less `[ADX] manifest.json - Missing required prop "<name>" (...)` message whose parenthetical matches the source.
The emitted glue bakes the merged props (not just manifest defaults); the hydrate-parity test shows the DOM is unchanged after running the glue and before any event.
findings:
SHIPPED. New modules: src/behavior/compute-key.ts (bareComputedKey) and src/behavior/run.ts (runSetup). EXPORT_RE is now EXPORTED from src/behavior/scan.ts for reuse (run.ts strips only the leading `export ` keyword+whitespace of each match, spliced right-to-left). CodegenContext gained a REQUIRED `mergedProps: Record` field — any later code or test that builds a CodegenContext literal MUST supply it (test/helpers.ts makeCtx now sets mergedProps = state). resolveProps(manifest, data, source) is exported from src/compile.ts with PropSource = 'standalone'|'page'|'composed'; FEAT-002 (pages) must call it with source 'page', composition (FEAT-003) with 'composed'. runSetup returns { state, computed } where computed is ALREADY keyed by bareComputedKey (bare name -> lazy thunk), so compile.ts assigns scope.computed = computed directly (no re-keying). The sandbox state is the EXACT object setup() returned (no clone) and every get* thunk reads the same globalThis.__ADX_STATE__ reference. glue.ts buildProps now returns ctx.mergedProps verbatim (the __ADX_PROPS__ override still merges on top). CLI --data mirrors --tokens; loadData() throws CLI-level `[ADX] - Cannot read data file` / `Invalid JSON` / `Data must be a JSON object of props` and is caught by run()'s existing try/catch. Timeout detection in run.ts keys on err.code === 'ERR_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT' (falls back to a message regex). jsdom@29.1.1 added as an EXACT devDependency, deliberately kept OUT of package.json `files` (dist/tokens/README.md only); its transitive npm-audit warnings are dev-only and do not affect the shipped package. The hydrate-parity test writes glue.js+behavior.js to a tmp dir and dynamic-import()s the glue with jsdom document/CustomEvent on globalThis. Fixture user-card/data.json = {"name":"Ada Lovelace"}; compile.test.ts + seo-contract.test.ts now pass data and assert a non-empty

Ada Lovelace

. Standalone `adx check` on user-card WITHOUT --data now fails required-prop validation (intended, design Risk 6). Docs were NOT touched (doc-sync is FEAT-006's job per plan). Tests: 99 pass (77 M1 + 22 new), tsc clean, eslint clean.
